question: Which provinces have never had a tribute shortfall caused by corruption, and who is their current governor, if any?
gold_sql: SELECT p.name AS province, o.name AS governor, o.status AS governor_status FROM provinces p LEFT JOIN officials o ON p.governor_id = o.official_id WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tribute_records tr WHERE tr.province_id = p.province_id AND tr.shortfall_reason = 'corruption') ORDER BY p.name
notes: TOY EXAMPLE. LEFT JOIN (to keep provinces with no governor on record) combined with a NOT EXISTS anti-join against tribute_records. Germania Superior has no governor at all, so its governor fields are null rather than filtered out.
